input.quote: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.
input.rationale: Section 7(a) caps Contractor's liability at fees actually paid for the particular Statement of Work — a per-SOW "fees paid" basis with no 12-month measure and no monetary floor, which can fall well below six months' fees and is not a meaningful remedy. The only carve-out is a cross-reference to "Paragraph 9", which is the Independent Contractor clause (no indemnity exists in the Agreement, despite the section caption), so in practice there are no carve-outs for confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement. Our payment obligations are also swept into the cap. Section 7(b)'s mutual consequential-damages waiver is acceptable. Redline sets a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, adds uncapped Excluded Claims, and confirms fees due are not subject to the cap; fallback is a mutual 12 months' fees cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with uncapped Excluded Claims
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the cap mutual and set it at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, replacing the per-Statement-of-Work "fees paid" basis, which is not a meaningful remedy. Indemnification, confidentiality/data protection and security breaches, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and our payment obligations are not subject to it; if helpful we can fall back to a mutual twelve months' fees cap with those carve-outs.

ops.newText: (a) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (I) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY COMPANY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (II) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (USD 1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. COMPANY'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
